metadata.source: 2020-2024 ACS five-year B19001 via IPUMS NHGIS ds272
metadata.geography_method: Whole block groups; 2020 tract/NTA/CDTA relationships. CDTAs are community-district approximations; special areas and cross-borough assignments retained. Boroughs follow source county, not CDTA.
metadata.boundary_method: Union of 2024 TIGER block-group polygons, not official NTA/CD boundaries.
